capabilities: Extract dates and times from note prose with NLP in several languages
Render an interactive timeline inside a historica code block
Edit entries with significance sliders, notes, and vault attachments
Export timelines as PNG, HTML, Markdown, JSON, or plain text
Auto-save timelines as plain-Markdown HMD files and browse a Global Timeline view
extras: Desktop only; mobile support was dropped in version 0.3. Full user and API documentation live on separate sites (historica.pages.dev, obsidian-historica-code-doc.pages.dev).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to detect dates scattered in prose and turn them into a visual, editable timeline.
summary: NLP timeline generator that extracts dates from note prose and renders an interactive timeline inside a code block.
